musicTrials.prompt: A 90-second excerpt of a folk ballad sung in Vietnamese for a video game about the Trưng sisters, two queens who led an army of women against Han rule in ancient Vietnam around 40 CE. Traditional northern Vietnamese style with a modern cinematic folk production. Open with 16-string zither (đàn tranh) alone, then one verse sung by a single woman, gentle and proud, then a chorus by two women in close quan họ-style harmony over deep bronze kettle drums, soft strings and bamboo flute (sáo trúc). 84 BPM, D minor pentatonic. Sing on Vietnamese vocables (à ơi, hò), no English. Avoid Chinese or Japanese instrument colour (no guzheng, erhu, pipa, koto, shakuhachi), rock or trap drums, EDM drops and trailer-style braams.
